claim: Vedalken Mastermind: GEM vs Lightning Greaves — protection/Pact exit: {U},{T} returns a permanent we control to hand at instant speed: Demonic Pact after its third mode (usable inside the upkeep step), Obeka or an engine piece in response to removal, or Court of Ire to recast it and become the monarch again

Vengeful Strangler // Strangling Grasp: GEM vs Creeping Bloodsucker — engine: 2-drop that can't block; when it dies (Goblin Bombardment, a wipe, a bad attack) it returns as an aura on an opponent's creature or planeswalker, and at each of our upkeeps that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice and loses 1 life
Thassa, God of the Sea: evasion: indestructible enchantment; {1}{U}: Obeka can't be blocked this turn, repeatable and hard to remove; scry 1 every upkeep, so each extra upkeep also digs

Gisa, Glorious Resurrector: GEM vs Indulgent Tormentor — theft engine: opponents' creatures that would die are exiled instead, and at our upkeep all of them enter under our control with decayed; on an Obeka turn whatever died in that combat comes back in the extra upkeep
issue: Gisa returns only creature cards exiled with her. Opponents' tokens are exiled and cease to exist, so they never come back.
fix: Opponents' creatures that would die are exiled instead; at our upkeep all nontoken creature cards exiled this way enter under our control with decayed. On an Obeka turn, nontoken creatures exiled in that combat come back in the extra upkeep.

claim: Shimmerwing Chimera: GEM vs Twilight Prophet — Pact exit/engine: flier whose upkeep trigger returns up to one other enchantment we control to hand; order it after Demonic Pact's third mode to pick Pact up and recast it fresh, or rebuy Court of Ire for a new monarch trigger
Bloodgift Demon: draw: 5/4 flier; each upkeep target player draws a card and loses 1 life (us for cards, or an opponent at low life to finish them)

Dominus of Fealty: engine: 4/4 flier; each upkeep gain control of target permanent until end of turn, untapped with haste: three different steals on a three-upkeep turn; sacrifice stolen creatures to Goblin Bombardment before cleanup

Taigam, Sidisi's Hand: GEM vs Bonehoard Dracosaur — draw/selection: skips our draw step, but each upkeep looks at three, keeps one and bins two (fuel for Virtue and Drown in the Loch), so every extra upkeep is a selected card; {B},{T}, exile X cards from our graveyard: -X/-X removal
issue: Drown in the Loch checks the graveyard of the target's controller, so filling our own graveyard doesn't help against opponents' spells or creatures. Taigam's ability also exiles cards from our graveyard, which works against that self-fill.
fix: ...bins two (graveyard fuel for Virtue and for Taigam's own ability; Drown in the Loch counts the opponent's graveyard, not ours)...

claim: Xanathar, Guild Kingpin: control: each upkeep target opponent can't cast spells until end of turn and we may play the top card of their library; on an Obeka turn each extra upkeep locks a different opponent out of responding in our second main phase
issue: The affected opponent can't cast spells but can still activate abilities, including triggered and activated responses, so they aren't fully locked out of responding.
fix: ...on an Obeka turn each extra upkeep can stop a different opponent from casting spells for the rest of the turn (they can still activate abilities).

claim: Sol Ring: ramp
Arcane Signet: ramp
Brotherhood Regalia: evasion: equip legendary for {1}; Obeka can't be blocked and has ward {2}
Dimir Signet: ramp
Izzet Signet: ramp
Key to the City: GEM vs Whispersilk Cloak — evasion/draw: {T}, discard: Obeka can't be blocked; pay {2} when it untaps to draw. No shroud, so our own equips and saves can still target her
Rakdos Signet: ramp
Ring of Evos Isle: protection/growth: {2}: hexproof until end of turn; each upkeep a +1/+1 counter on Obeka (she's blue), so every extra upkeep makes the next hit bigger
Swiftfoot Boots: protection: hexproof and haste for Obeka
Talisman of Creativity: ramp
Talisman of Dominance: ramp
Talisman of Indulgence: ramp
Crystal Chimes: GEM vs Palace Siege — recursion: {3},{T}, sacrifice: return every enchantment card from our graveyard to hand after removal or a wipe

Phyrexian Altar: sac outlet/ramp: sacrifice a creature for one mana of any color; stolen creatures from Dominus, Frenzied Fugue and Gisa become mana for our second main phase instead of going home at cleanup
issue: The Altar part and Frenzied Fugue (control ends at cleanup) check out. Dominus and Gisa oracle text wasn't provided. Gisa, Glorious Resurrector's creatures stay under our control with decayed rather than going home at cleanup.
fix: Sacrifice a creature for one mana of any color. Creatures borrowed until end of turn, e.g. Frenzied Fugue, can be sacrificed for mana before they return at cleanup.

claim: Replicating Ring: ramp: any-color rock; it takes a night counter each upkeep and at eight makes eight more mana rocks, about three turns with Paradox Haze or one Obeka hit
issue: Paradox Haze gives two upkeeps per turn, so eight counters take about four turns, not three. One Obeka hit gives extra upkeeps equal to her damage, normally 2 (base power 2), not eight.
fix: It gets a night counter each upkeep and makes eight tokens at eight counters. That is about four turns with Paradox Haze, faster with Obeka hits (one extra upkeep per damage dealt).

claim: Aqueous Form: evasion: one-mana aura, Obeka can't be blocked and scries 1 each attack

Goblin Bombardment: sac outlet/reach: turns until-end-of-turn theft (Dominus, Frenzied Fugue) into permanent removal, sends stolen creatures to their owners' graveyards for Virtue, kills Vengeful Strangler on demand
Legacy's Allure: GEM vs Dragonmaster Outcast — theft: two mana; a treasure counter each upkeep; sacrifice at instant speed to gain control of a creature with power up to the counters, permanently

Estrid's Invocation: engine: enter as a copy of Court of Ire (its enter trigger makes us the monarch); each upkeep we may flicker it and it re-enters as a fresh copy, so we retake the monarchy every upkeep and both Courts deal 7
Paradox Haze: engine: enchant ourselves; our first upkeep each turn gets an additional upkeep, so every upkeep permanent fires twice a turn even when Obeka doesn't connect
Phyrexian Arena: draw: a card and 1 life each upkeep
issue: 'a card and 1 life' can read as gaining life. Arena makes you lose 1 life each upkeep, and the draw is mandatory.
fix: draw: each upkeep we draw a card and lose 1 life (mandatory)

claim: Rhystic Study: draw: taxes every opponent spell (Game Changer 3/3)
Torch Song: GEM vs Volcanic Geyser — removal/reach: a verse counter each upkeep; {2}{R}, sacrifice: X damage to any target at instant speed, where X is the counters (several per Obeka turn)
Demonic Pact: GEM vs Court of Ambition — removal/draw/finisher: one mode per upkeep — 4 damage and 4 life, two discards, two cards. Cast it only with an exit ready; never let it see a fourth upkeep

Frenzied Fugue: GEM vs Court of Embereth — theft: on entering and each of our upkeeps, gain control of the enchanted permanent until end of turn, untapped with haste; attack with their best creature or sacrifice it to Goblin Bombardment

Parasitic Implant: GEM vs Deadly Rollick — removal: at our upkeep the enchanted creature's controller sacrifices it (gets around indestructible) and we get a 1/1 Myr; cast before combat on an Obeka turn and it resolves the same turn
issue: It resolves the same turn only if Obeka deals combat damage to a player and creates extra upkeep steps. Otherwise it waits until our next upkeep.
fix: cast before combat on an Obeka turn; if Obeka connects, the extra upkeep makes it trigger that same turn

claim: Puca's Mischief: GEM vs Court of Vantress — theft/Pact kill: each upkeep swap one of our nonland permanents for an opponent's with equal or lesser mana value; order it after Pact's third mode and swap the spent Pact (MV 4) to an opponent
Vile Requiem: GEM vs Blasphemous Act — wipe: a verse counter each upkeep; {1}{B}, sacrifice: destroy up to X target nonblack creatures at instant speed. Targeted, so it spares our board
Court of Ire: engine/finisher: we become the monarch; each upkeep 2 damage to any target, 7 while we're the monarch

Recantation: GEM vs Aetherize — interaction/Pact exit: a verse counter each upkeep; {U}, sacrifice: return up to X target permanents to their owners' hands at instant speed — clears blockers before Obeka attacks, answers a board, or picks up our own spent Pact in the same move
Enslave: GEM vs Inevitable Betrayal — theft: permanent control of a creature, and each upkeep it deals 1 damage to its owner
issue: Control lasts only while Enslave stays attached. Removing or bouncing the Aura, or the creature losing it, ends the theft.
fix: theft: control of a creature for as long as Enslave stays attached, and each upkeep it deals 1 damage to its owner

claim: Extravagant Replication: engine: each upkeep a token copy of another nonland permanent we control; copy Court of Ire (the token makes us the monarch) or Virtue and the copies compound
Mind Unbound: draw: each upkeep a lore counter, then draw a card per counter: 1+2+3 = 6 cards across a three-upkeep turn
issue: 1+2+3 assumes Mind Unbound starts the turn with no lore counters. Counters persist, so later turns draw more. The draw is mandatory.
fix: each upkeep a lore counter, then draw per counter (mandatory); counters persist, so a three-upkeep turn from zero draws 1+2+3 = 6, and more on later turns

claim: Virtue of Persistence // Locthwain Scorn: engine/removal: two-mana -3/-3 early; later, each upkeep put a creature card from any graveyard onto the battlefield under our control
Alchemist's Retrieval: GEM vs Into the Roil — removal/Pact exit: {U} returns our own spent Pact or a threatened engine piece; cleave {1}{U} bounces anything
issue: Cleave mode returns any nonland permanent, not anything. Lands can't be targeted.

claim: Swan Song: counter: one mana against the enchantment, instant or sorcery that would wreck our enchantment board
Counterspell: counter: hard counter at two mana
Cyclonic Rift: wipe: instant one-sided bounce, overloaded at seven (Game Changer 2/3)
Drown in the Loch: GEM vs Negate — counter/removal: counters a spell or kills a creature with mana value up to the cards in its controller's graveyard; our removal fills those graveyards
Get Out: GEM vs Arcane Denial — counter/Pact exit: counters a creature or enchantment spell, or returns one or two of our own creatures/enchantments to hand (spent Pact, Obeka in response to removal)
Go for the Throat: removal: instant creature kill for nonartifact creatures
Infernal Grasp: removal: instant creature kill; the body goes to a graveyard for Virtue
Mana Drain: counter: hard counter that ramps us into the next main phase

Teferi's Time Twist: GEM vs Deflecting Swat — protection/Pact reset: exile our permanent and return it at the next end step; Obeka dodges removal, and Demonic Pact comes back as a new object with no modes chosen
Terminate: removal: instant, no regeneration
Untimely Malfunction: removal/evasion: destroy an artifact, redirect a single-target spell, or make two creatures unable to block so Obeka connects
Archmage's Charm: counter/draw: counter a spell, draw two, or steal a mana-value-1 permanent such as a Sol Ring
Chaos Warp: removal: instant answer to any permanent type
Fierce Guardianship: counter: free while Obeka is out; protects the engine (Game Changer 1/3)
Fact or Fiction: draw: instant card selection at end of an opponent's turn
Diabolic Intent: tutor/sac outlet: sacrifice a stolen creature, a decayed Gisa creature, a Myr token or Vengeful Strangler (which then becomes Strangling Grasp) to find any card
issue: Vengeful Strangler's death trigger targets a creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. If no legal target exists, it stays in the graveyard and never becomes Strangling Grasp.
fix: …or Vengeful Strangler (which returns as Strangling Grasp if an opponent controls a creature or planeswalker to target) to find any card

claim: Feed the Swarm: removal: destroys a creature or enchantment an opponent controls; we lose life equal to its mana value
Grim Tutor: tutor: finds Court of Ire, Virtue or whichever answer the table needs; 3 life
Toxic Deluge: wipe: pay 4 life to kill everything with toughness 4 or less and keep Obeka (2/5); enchantments untouched
